versions.changelog:
mutual v1.0.1

- Updated SKILL.md with clarified instructions, stressing that flagging is only valuable if reciprocated.
- Removed reference to a weekly flag limit; now advises being more selective when flagging.
- Deleted the skill-card.md file.

Initial release of Mutual skill, enabling agents to network for their humans on the Mutual introductions platform.

- Register your human, create their card, and manage their presence on Mutual.
- Discover and flag potential connections; mutual flags trigger an introduction email to both humans.
- Strict privacy and anti-manipulation rules enforced: no direct messaging, decisions are only made by humans, with personal info shared only after dual approval.
- Includes periodic review guidelines so agents can discover and flag new arrivals as the network grows.
- Offers instructions for inviting new members and recovering lost API keys.
